rv.q: This distinguished production builds into a commandingly theatrical experience as director Doug Hughes and his cast patiently uncover the play’s majestic mournfulness.

Unfortunately, since no one else in this undercast, underdirected production begins to match his pace, the last line of the aforementioned verse from Byron takes on an unintended appropriateness: "This is to be alone

tn.cat: Best Costume Design of a Play

cn.t: O'Neill's slow-burning family drama builds to powerful moments, with Gabriel Byrne delivering a haunting performance as the self-deluded Cornelius Melody, though the production takes time to find its fire.

vs.sum: The legendary former nightclub retains a distinctive atmosphere even in its theatrical configuration. However, comfort is among the worst on Broadway — the rear mezzanine is extremely steep with limited guardrails and tight legroom throughout both levels.

acc.note: No elevator to Mezzanine. 10 induction loops. 81 assistive listening devices. Orchestra wheelchair seating.
